business_outcome: Extend the existing Run 015 UI Excellence Team so each assignment researches current best-in-class interfaces in the exact niche, derives product-specific art direction, compares proposed visual DNA against prior Factory outputs, and fails closed on unexplained cross-product design convergence without weakening any existing functional-preservation or independent-QA safeguard.
existing_owner_scan: Run 015 already owns benchmark, art direction, design-system normalization, UIX-100 scoring and independent visual QA. The defect is inside that existing loop: benchmark research is underspecified, portfolio memory is absent, and brand distinction is not a critical gate. No new team is required.
reuse_candidates_checked: existing Run 015 functional-equivalence and repair-regression controls
duplication_analysis: This is a surgical extension of Run 015. Web benchmark acquisition, visual-genome extraction, divergent art-direction generation and portfolio-similarity review are added as responsibilities and deterministic gates inside the existing team rather than creating a separate design-research team.
residual_unowned_loop: Run 015 can currently produce high-scoring interfaces that converge on a recurring house style because it lacks mandatory niche-web evidence, three meaningfully divergent directions, durable portfolio fingerprints and a fail-closed similarity gate.
evidence_ref: Owner observation 2026-08-31; Asteron and Njia palette/geometry comparison; current Run 015 operating contract, runtime quality gate and deterministic regression suite.
promotion_constraints: All pre-extension Run 015 functional-preservation, viewport, independent-QA and regression protections remain mandatory
Each new assignment must produce a current niche benchmark dossier before art direction

Benchmark target is 8-15 current interfaces with at least four direct-niche references and explicit typography, palette, layout, component, interaction, data-presentation, imagery/iconography and mobile observations
Art direction must present at least three meaningfully divergent visual genomes before selection
The selected direction must be compared against the durable Run 015 portfolio visual-genome registry
Brand distinction, niche appropriateness and portfolio distinction each fail closed below 90
Unrelated-product visual similarity above the configured threshold yields REVISE unless independent QA establishes a documented domain or brand reason
No existing score threshold may be lowered and no existing critical dimension may be removed
No production deployment or master mutation is authorized by this extension
